coke.name: Coca-Cola
coke.ingredientsText: Carbonated water, sugar, colour (caramel E150d), phosphoric acid, natural flavourings including caffeine.

dietCoke.name: Diet Coke
dietCoke.ingredientsText: Carbonated water, colour (caramel E150d), sweeteners (aspartame, acesulfame K), natural flavourings including caffeine, phosphoric acid, citric acid.

nutella.name: Nutella
nutella.ingredientsText: Sugar, palm oil, hazelnuts (13%), skimmed milk powder (8.7%), fat-reduced cocoa (7.4%), emulsifier: lecithins (soya), vanillin.

gum.name: Sugar-free chewing gum
gum.ingredientsText: Sweeteners (sorbitol, mannitol, maltitol syrup, aspartame, acesulfame K), gum base, flavourings, thickener (gum arabic), humectant (glycerol), emulsifier (soy lecithin), colour (E171), antioxidant (BHA).

chips.name: Magic Masala potato chips
chips.ingredientsText: Potato, edible vegetable oil (palmolein, rice bran oil), seasoning (spices & condiments (onion powder, chilli powder, garlic powder, coriander, ginger), sugar, salt, black salt, tomato powder), flavour enhancers (627, 631), anticaking agent (551).

bread.name: Whole wheat bread
bread.ingredientsText: Whole wheat flour (atta), water, yeast, sugar, salt, wheat gluten, vegetable oil.

biscuitTyped.name: Cream biscuits
biscuitTyped.ingredientsText: Sugar, refined wheat flour (maida), palm oil, cocoa solids, glucose syrup, emulsifier (471), raising agent (500(ii)), salt, artificial flavour.

almondMilk.name: Almond drink
almondMilk.ingredientsText: Water, almonds (2%), calcium phosphate, stabiliser (407), salt

proteinBar.name: Protein bar
proteinBar.ingredientsText: Milk protein, maltitol, chicory root fibre, cocoa butter, polydextrose, almonds, sucralose, emulsifier (soy lecithin), salt

masalaNoodles.name: Masala instant noodles
masalaNoodles.ingredientsText: Refined wheat flour (maida), palm oil, iodised salt, wheat gluten, thickeners (508 & 412), acidity regulators (501(i) & 500(i)), humectant (451(i)), tastemaker (mixed spices (onion powder, coriander, chilli powder, garlic powder, turmeric), sugar, hydrolysed groundnut protein, flavour enhancer (635), colour (150d))
